turns.doctor_question: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Nice to meet you too. Well, I guess what finally got me to come in here is that my work is really starting to suffer. I'm an electrician, and lately, I just... I can't seem to keep my focus on one thing. 

Like, if I'm sitting down to look at an estimate or fill out a code form, I get pulled off track so easily. It could be a tool making a noise in the background, my phone buzzing with a text, or even just some new idea I get about reorganizing the workshop. I'll drop what I'm doing and focus on that instead. Because of it, my jobs are starting to get all mixed up, and I can't really afford for that to happen. I just need to figure out how to keep my head straight so I can actually get my work done.
